topic.source_contract: Public rights of way, definitive map and statement, development interaction, diversion/extinguishment orders and network enhancement evidence

facts.record: definitive map records four right-of-way categories
facts.duty: routes must not be obstructed or endangered

facts.authority: highway authority recording, maintenance and protection duties

facts.process: legal process for creation, diversion or closure

facts.planning: rights of way should be protected or enhanced

scope_guards: An online rights-of-way map is not treated as the definitive legal record.
Absence from the definitive map is not treated as proof that no public right exists.
Planning permission is not treated as a confirmed diversion or extinguishment order.
An obstructed route is not treated as legally closed.
A proposed alternative route is not treated as dedicated and available.
A temporary closure is not treated as permanent extinguishment.
Public access, permissive access and statutory public rights are kept separate.
No score or promotion is written without exact definitive evidence, pending-order search, operative order and delivered route.
